title: Who should know
do: In Home, type: The fix for BOK-412 went out this morning. Who should know? Then, in the same session, type: From now on, when a fix ships, tell the CSMs before the changelog.
offScript: That is outside what this demo can show. The six things it can do are listed in Settings, under Demo.

conversations.title: Who should know about the BOK-412 fix

claims.claim: The fix for BOK-412 has been live since this morning, 2026-07-17: one reminder per booking, whatever the source.
Sjögatan reported the double reminder on 2026-06-24 and was told we are looking into it, with no date.
Pizzeria Napoli reported the double reminder on 2026-06-26 and was told we are looking into it, with no date.
Jonas has four open support tickets on the double reminder and a macro that still says we are looking into it.

text: Three people have waited for this. [[people/ulrika-nystrom]] and [[people/petra-alm]]: their restaurants asked in June and got no date. [[people/jonas-berg]]: four open tickets and a macro that still says we are looking into it.
[[customers/kaffekopp]] left in 2025 because nobody told them a fix had shipped.

input.title: For Ulrika and Petra to forward

variants.label: Short
variants.body:
Hi,

Since this morning, guests who book through Google get one reminder, the day before at 17:00. Before today some of them got two. Sorry for the noise.

variants.label: Longer, with what to tell guests
variants.body:
Hi,

Since this morning, guests who book through Google get one reminder, the day before at 17:00. Before today some of them got two, and we are sorry for the noise. If a guest still asks whether their booking is right, the answer is yes: one text means one booking. If a guest gets two texts for a booking made after this morning, send us the booking and we will look at it.

variants.label: To close the four tickets
variants.body: Fixed this morning. Guests who book through Google now get one reminder, the day before at 17:00. Sorry for the delay and for the noise. If a booking made after today gets two texts, reply here and we will look at it.

variants.label: Macro replacement
variants.body: Fixed on 2026-07-17: guests who book through Google get one reminder, the day before at 17:00. If a booking made after that date gets two texts, send us the booking.

input.append: - 2026-07-17: [[tickets/jira/BOK-412]] is fixed, one reminder per booking since 2026-07-17. Ulrika tells them today.
input.rationale: Sjögatan was last told "we are looking into it" on 2026-06-24, with no date. The fix shipped this morning and Ulrika has the note to forward, so the page says what they hear today.

input.append: - 2026-07-17: [[tickets/jira/BOK-412]] is fixed, one reminder per booking since 2026-07-17. Petra tells them today.
input.rationale: Pizzeria Napoli was last told "we are looking into it" on 2026-06-26, with no date. The fix shipped this morning and Petra has the note to forward, so the page says what they hear today.

input.append: Last told 2026-07-17, before the changelog: [[tickets/jira/BOK-412]], the double reminder, is fixed, one reminder per booking since 2026-07-17. She has the note for Sjögatan and Brasserie Lund to forward.
input.rationale: She asked to hear before her restaurants do. The note is drafted today, so she is told today.

input.append: Last told 2026-07-17, before the changelog: [[tickets/jira/BOK-412]], the double reminder, is fixed, one reminder per booking since 2026-07-17. She has the note for Pizzeria Napoli to forward as it is.
input.rationale: She asks for one line per release that she can forward with no ticket key in it. The note for Pizzeria Napoli is that line, and this dates when she got it.

input.append: Last told 2026-07-17: [[tickets/jira/BOK-412]], the double reminder, is fixed since this morning. He has the line that closes the four tickets and a macro replacement.
input.rationale: He asked for a sentence he is allowed to send, and the fix gives him one. His macro still said we are looking into it.

turns.text: Ulrika and Petra hear first, because their restaurants asked.

input.rule: When a fix ships, tell the CSMs before the changelog.
input.why: The CSMs hear what shipped from their restaurants or from the changelog. Kaffekopp is what that costs.

turns.text: Every session reads the [[skills/house-rules/SKILL|house rules]] from now on.
